description: Source code for the Sensor class implementation in Android HAL, managing sensor activation, batching, flushing, event reading, and thread handling.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: Implementation of sensor management including activation, batching, flushing, event reading, and threading.

methods.name: Sensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing sensor and starting the run thread.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Sets the sensor sampling period within allowed min and max delays.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Generates a flush complete event if sensor is enabled and not one-shot.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Static method to start the sensor's run loop.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for sensor event generation and thread management.

methods.name: isWakeUpSensor
